text:
Sam: Tiny PSA: someone left a stack of post-its on the microwave with a haiku. Who's the poet? :sticky_note:
Riya: Guilty pls tell me it's flattering haiku and not a passive-aggressive note about dishes. :eyes:
Tom: I wrote one as a test. It said:
Tom: "Steamed lunch, cold plate / dishes dream of running away / wash me, give me peace"
Ellen: Amazing. That belongs in the foyer. Also, big thanks to @Riya for bringing cookies this morning 36a389
Riya: Cookies were experimental almond-ginger — 3 people survived. The rest were short-lived. :sweat_smile:
Sam: Cookie survivors get a sticker. Sticker distribution at noon. :star2:
BotChef: Inventory update: cookie count - 3. Coffee supply - full. Plant water level - 68%.
Tom: One-liner of the day: "I put my plants on a schedule; now they have better time-management than me."
Ellen: Quick poll: should we pin the haiku to the corkboard? React :+1: yes, :wave: meh, :laughing: more haikus please.
Riya: :+1: (haiku = culture win)
Sam: :laughing: (but only if the post-it is laminated)
Tom: :wave: (I'll write a sequel haiku if you bribe me with a cookie)
BotChef: Reminder: label leftovers. Unlabeled food at 72hrs -> office snack auction. :gavel:
Ellen: Also shoutout to facilities for fixing the broken recycling bin this morning. Quick and painless. :recycle:
Sam: Alright haiku is pinned, cookies were heroic, and the post-it poet will remain anonymous for now. If you wrote one and want attribution, DM me. Meeting adjourned to the snack table. :tada:
